claims.explanation: Pyrimethamine selectively kills cancer cell lines through inhibition of DHFR and one-carbon metabolism, with sensitivity enhanced by MAPK pathway activation (e.g., KRAS mutation) and TP53 loss, while resistance is conferred by high expression of DHFR or the efflux transporter SLC47A1, as well as mutations in chromatin remodelers/oxidative stress genes (ARID1A, KMT2D, NFE2L2, CTNNB1). The pattern suggests that lines with high DHFR/SLC47A1 or with protective chromatin/oxidative stress mutations survive, whereas those with MAPK-driven proliferation and defective cell cycle checkpoints are more sensitive.
